programs.description: Sourav Ganguly hosts celebrity contestants as they live together in a common house, compete in various challenges and have to deal with each other's differences in order to win the prize.
Bringing the best in television.
Parashuram, a mild-mannered family man, leads a double life as an undercover agent, without the knowledge of his wife and children.

Sreemoyee, a dedicated housewife, takes care of her family. However, when she realises that they are taking her for granted, she decides to reclaim her dignity and goes on a journey of self-discovery.
Cousins Moni and Rashi marry into the wealthy Modak family, seemingly living a dream. However, Moni soon finds herself battling conspiracies from unexpected quarters.
A determined young woman strives to restore her family's honour by establishing a bank while navigating complex relationships and societal challenges.
Bidya works as an anatomy professor and a nighttime vigilante. She applies classroom knowledge to deliver justice, one bone at a time.

Defying her 'ill-fated' reputation, the resilient widow Kumkum marries Ishan and revitalises their declining leather enterprise. Furthermore, her visionary designs subsequently catalyse this global triumph.
Parashuram, a mild-mannered family man, leads a double life as an undercover agent, without the knowledge of his wife and children.
Rahi plans to stay in India while Titli dreams of America. Rahul desires Titli, but Rahi has feelings for Rahul, creating a complex love triangle.
Years after a staged accident separated them, Pori and Abhimanyu find their paths crossing once more. Now a sign language expert and a lawyer, the pair must navigate a new chapter of their lives.
A determined young woman strives to restore her family's honour by establishing a bank while navigating complex relationships and societal challenges.
Growing up as an orphan, Gangaa moves through life fighting societal injustice. Later, she crosses paths with Arjun, a righteous cop, which changes the course of her life.
After falling in love with Mallar, the youngest son in an affection-starved, all-male family, Meghla sets out to turn their disorganised residence into a warm, loving home.
